prompt.en: She ___ to school every day.
prompt.zh: 选出正确的答案。She ___ to school every day.

explain.en: She is singular; a daily habit uses the present simple goes.
explain.zh: She 是单数主语；every day 表示习惯，go 要加 -es。

prompt.en: They ___ football on Saturdays.
prompt.zh: 选出正确的答案。They ___ football on Saturdays.

explain.en: They is plural; a regular Saturday activity uses play without -s.
explain.zh: They 是复数主语；描述星期六的习惯时用 play，不加 -s。

prompt.en: My brother ___ his homework after dinner.
prompt.zh: 选出正确的答案。My brother ___ his homework after dinner.

explain.en: My brother is singular, so the present simple form is does.
explain.zh: My brother 是单数，do 在一般现在式中变成 does。

prompt.en: I ___ breakfast at seven o'clock every morning.
prompt.zh: 选出正确的答案。I ___ breakfast at seven o'clock every morning.

explain.en: Every morning signals a habit. With I, use the base form eat.
explain.zh: Every morning 表示习惯；主语是 I，动词用原形 eat。

prompt.en: The cat ___ water every morning.
prompt.zh: 选出最合适的答案。The cat ___ water every morning.

explain.en: The cat is singular. For a daily habit, drink becomes drinks.
explain.zh: The cat 是单数；描述每天的习惯，drink 要加 -s。

prompt.en: We ___ our teeth twice a day.
prompt.zh: 选出正确的答案。We ___ our teeth twice a day.

explain.en: We takes the base verb brush when describing a habit.
explain.zh: We 后面用动词原形 brush；twice a day 表示每天两次的习惯。

prompt.en: Each of the boys ___ ready for the test.
prompt.zh: 选出正确的答案。Each of the boys ___ ready for the test.

explain.en: Each means every person separately, so each takes singular is.
explain.zh: Each 强调每一个人，因此即使后面有 boys，也用单数动词 is。

prompt.en: Each of the students ___ a book to read right now.
prompt.zh: 选出最合适的答案。Each of the students ___ a book to read right now.

explain.en: Each is singular; right now rules out the past form had. Use has.
explain.zh: Each 强调每一个学生，应用 has；right now 表示现在，不能用过去式 had。

prompt.en: Yesterday, I ___ an apple for breakfast.
prompt.zh: 选出正确的答案。Yesterday, I ___ an apple for breakfast.

explain.en: Yesterday tells us the action is past. Eat changes to ate.
explain.zh: Yesterday 表示昨天，eat 的过去式是 ate。

prompt.en: She ___ to the market last Sunday.
prompt.zh: 选出正确的答案。She ___ to the market last Sunday.

explain.en: Last Sunday is in the past; go has the irregular past form went.
explain.zh: Last Sunday 表示过去的时间；go 的不规则过去式是 went。

prompt.en: We ___ a movie last night.
prompt.zh: 选出正确的答案。We ___ a movie last night.

explain.en: Last night is past time. Add -ed to watch to make watched.
explain.zh: Last night 表示过去；watch 加 -ed 变成 watched。

prompt.en: He ___ his bicycle to school yesterday.
prompt.zh: 选出正确的答案。He ___ his bicycle to school yesterday.

explain.en: Yesterday requires the past tense; ride becomes rode.
explain.zh: Yesterday 表示过去；ride 的过去式是 rode。

prompt.en: Last Sunday, they ___ a beautiful sandcastle at the beach.
prompt.zh: 选出最合适的答案。Last Sunday, they ___ a beautiful sandcastle at the beach.

explain.en: Last Sunday anchors this action in the past; build becomes built.
explain.zh: Last Sunday 明确表示过去；build 的过去式是 built。

prompt.en: I ___ my homework before dinner last night.
prompt.zh: 选出正确的答案。I ___ my homework before dinner last night.

explain.en: Last night requires finished, the past form of finish.
explain.zh: Last night 表示过去，因此 finish 要变成 finished。

prompt.en: Complete the past-tense sentence: We ___ not visit the museum yesterday because it was closed.
prompt.zh: 选出最合适的答案。Complete the past-tense sentence: We ___ not visit the museum yesterday because it was closed.

explain.en: A negative past-simple sentence uses did not followed by the base verb visit.
explain.zh: 一般过去式的否定句用 did not，后面的 visit 保留原形。

prompt.en: She ___ swimming when it began to rain.
prompt.zh: 选出正确的答案。She ___ swimming when it began to rain.

explain.en: Was swimming describes an action in progress when the rain began. She takes was.
explain.zh: Was swimming 表示下雨时正在游泳，是过去进行式；She 后用 was。

prompt.en: Look! The dog ___ in the park.
prompt.zh: 选出正确的答案。Look! The dog ___ in the park.

explain.en: Look points to an action now. The dog takes is + running.
explain.zh: Look 提示动作正在发生；The dog 是单数，应用 is running。

prompt.en: Listen! The birds ___ outside.
prompt.zh: 选出正确的答案。Listen! The birds ___ outside.

explain.en: Listen points to an action now. The plural birds takes are singing.
explain.zh: Listen 提示正在发生的动作；birds 是复数，用 are singing。

prompt.en: Right now, I ___ my homework.
prompt.zh: 选出正确的答案。Right now, I ___ my homework.

explain.en: Right now calls for the present continuous. With I, use am doing.
explain.zh: Right now 表示现在正在进行；I 后用 am doing。

prompt.en: She ___ a letter to her grandmother at the moment.
prompt.zh: 选出正确的答案。She ___ a letter to her grandmother at the moment.

explain.en: At the moment means now. She takes is writing.
explain.zh: At the moment 表示此刻；She 后用 is writing，表示正在写信。

prompt.en: Complete with the past continuous form: While I ___ dinner, my sister was setting the table.
prompt.zh: 选出最合适的答案。Complete with the past continuous form: While I ___ dinner, my sister was setting the table.

explain.en: Past continuous uses was/were + -ing. I takes was cooking for the ongoing past action.
explain.zh: 过去进行式用 was/were 加动词 -ing；I 后用 was cooking，表示当时正在煮饭。

prompt.en: Use the present continuous for an arranged plan: They ___ to Penang next week for a holiday.
prompt.zh: 选出最合适的答案。Use the present continuous for an arranged plan: They ___ to Penang next week for a holiday.

explain.en: For the requested present-continuous plan, use are + travelling with They.
explain.zh: 题目指定用现在进行式表示已安排的计划；They 后用 are travelling。

prompt.en: Choose a or an: I saw ___ elephant at the zoo.
prompt.zh: 选出最合适的答案。Choose a or an: I saw ___ elephant at the zoo.

explain.en: Elephant begins with a vowel sound, so choose an.
explain.zh: Elephant 以元音开头；a 和 an 之中应选 an。

prompt.en: Choose a or an: She wants to be ___ doctor when she grows up.
prompt.zh: 选出最合适的答案。Choose a or an: She wants to be ___ doctor when she grows up.

explain.en: Doctor begins with a consonant sound, so choose a.
explain.zh: Doctor 以辅音开头，因此用 a doctor。

prompt.en: ___ sun rises in the east.
prompt.zh: 选出正确的答案。___ sun rises in the east.

explain.en: Use the for the sun, the one we refer to in our solar system.
explain.zh: 谈到太阳时使用定冠词 the，句首 The 要大写。

prompt.en: Choose a or an: He bought ___ umbrella because it was raining.
prompt.zh: 选出最合适的答案。Choose a or an: He bought ___ umbrella because it was raining.

explain.en: Umbrella begins with a vowel sound, so use an umbrella.
explain.zh: Umbrella 以元音开头，因此用 an umbrella。

prompt.en: ___ Petronas Towers are located in Kuala Lumpur.
prompt.zh: 选出正确的答案。___ Petronas Towers are located in Kuala Lumpur.

explain.en: The is used before the plural name Petronas Towers.
explain.zh: Petronas Towers 是这组双塔的名称，前面使用 The。

prompt.en: Choose a or an: I need ___ hour to finish my homework.
prompt.zh: 选出最合适的答案。Choose a or an: I need ___ hour to finish my homework.

explain.en: The h in hour is silent, so the first sound is a vowel: an hour.
explain.zh: Hour 的 h 不发音，开头是元音，因此用 an hour；判断时听发音。

prompt.en: My birthday is ___ May.
prompt.zh: 选出正确的答案。My birthday is ___ May.

explain.en: Use in with a month: in May.
explain.zh: 月份前面用 in，例如 in May。

prompt.en: We go to school ___ Monday.
prompt.zh: 选出正确的答案。We go to school ___ Monday.

explain.en: Use on with a named day: on Monday.
explain.zh: 星期几前面用 on，例如 on Monday。

prompt.en: The class starts ___ 8 o'clock.
prompt.zh: 选出正确的答案。The class starts ___ 8 o'clock.

explain.en: Use at for a clock time: at 8 o'clock.
explain.zh: 具体钟点前用 at，例如 at 8 o'clock。

prompt.en: I was born ___ 2015.
prompt.zh: 选出正确的答案。I was born ___ 2015.

explain.en: Use in with a year: in 2015.
explain.zh: 年份前用 in，例如 in 2015。

prompt.en: Choose the usual time expression: We can see the stars ___ night.
prompt.zh: 选出最合适的答案。Choose the usual time expression: We can see the stars ___ night.

explain.en: At night is the usual expression for the night-time period.
explain.zh: At night 是表示“在夜间”的常用时间表达。

prompt.en: She always visits her grandmother ___ Sunday.
prompt.zh: 选出正确的答案。She always visits her grandmother ___ Sunday.

explain.en: Use on with a day of the week: on Sunday.
explain.zh: 星期几前用 on，因此是 on Sunday。

prompt.en: The cat is inside the box. Complete with the same meaning: The cat is sleeping ___ the box.
prompt.zh: 选出最合适的答案。The cat is inside the box. Complete with the same meaning: The cat is sleeping ___ the box.

explain.en: In means inside; it keeps the meaning given in the first sentence.
explain.zh: In 表示在里面，与第一句的 inside 意思相同。

prompt.en: The book is resting on the top surface of the table. The book is ___ the table.
prompt.zh: 选出最合适的答案。The book is resting on the top surface of the table. The book is ___ the table.

explain.en: On describes contact with the upper surface of the table.
explain.zh: On 表示物品放在桌面的上方并与桌面接触。

prompt.en: The ball rolled into the space below the sofa. It is now ___ the sofa.
prompt.zh: 选出最合适的答案。The ball rolled into the space below the sofa. It is now ___ the sofa.

explain.en: Under means below something; the clue is the space below the sofa.
explain.zh: Under 表示在下面；线索是 space below the sofa。

prompt.en: The tree is between me and the dog, so I cannot see the dog. The dog is ___ the tree.
prompt.zh: 选出最合适的答案。The tree is between me and the dog, so I cannot see the dog. The dog is ___ the tree.

explain.en: Behind means at the back of something; the tree blocks the dog from view.
explain.zh: Behind 表示在后面；树挡住了视线，所以狗在树后。

prompt.en: The park is ___ the school and the library.
prompt.zh: 选出正确的答案。The park is ___ the school and the library.

explain.en: Between links two named places: the school and the library.
explain.zh: Between 表示在两者之间，这里是学校与图书馆之间。

prompt.en: Hang the picture flat against the wall: Put the picture ___ the wall.
prompt.zh: 选出最合适的答案。Hang the picture flat against the wall: Put the picture ___ the wall.

explain.en: A picture hanging flat against a wall is on the wall.
explain.zh: 挂在墙面上的画用 on the wall；这里明确说平贴着墙面。

prompt.en: Ali is my brother. ___ is very kind.
prompt.zh: 选出最合适的答案。Ali is my brother. ___ is very kind.

explain.en: He is the subject pronoun for Ali, identified here as a brother.
explain.zh: 第一句说明 Ali 是哥哥或弟弟，因此代词用 He。

prompt.en: Mei Ling is my sister. This is Mei Ling's bag. It is ___ bag.
prompt.zh: 选出最合适的答案。Mei Ling is my sister. This is Mei Ling's bag. It is ___ bag.

explain.en: Her before bag shows that the bag belongs to Mei Ling, identified as a sister.
explain.zh: Her 放在 bag 前表示所属；第一句已说明 Mei Ling 是姐姐或妹妹。

prompt.en: The children are playing. ___ are happy.
prompt.zh: 选出正确的答案。The children are playing. ___ are happy.

explain.en: The children is plural, so replace it with They.
explain.zh: The children 是复数，代替他们的主语代词是 They。

prompt.en: This pencil is mine. It is ___ pencil.
prompt.zh: 选出正确的答案。This pencil is mine. It is ___ pencil.

explain.en: Mine means belonging to me. Before the noun pencil, use my.
explain.zh: Mine 表示“我的”；名词 pencil 前要用 my，形成 my pencil。

prompt.en: My parents and I went to the fair. ___ had a great time.
prompt.zh: 选出正确的答案。My parents and I went to the fair. ___ had a great time.

explain.en: My parents and I includes the speaker, so use We.
explain.zh: My parents and I 包括说话者自己，因此用 We。

prompt.en: The students own these books. Complete with the same meaning: These are ___ books.
prompt.zh: 选出最合适的答案。The students own these books. Complete with the same meaning: These are ___ books.

explain.en: Their shows ownership by the students, a plural group.
explain.zh: 书属于这些学生；表示复数人称的所属关系，用 their books。

prompt.en: Join the two items in a list: I like apples ___ oranges.
prompt.zh: 选出最合适的答案。Join the two items in a list: I like apples ___ oranges.

explain.en: And adds the second item, oranges, to the list.
explain.zh: And 用来把 apples 和 oranges 两个项目连接起来。

prompt.en: Choose the word that shows a result: She was tired, ___ she went to sleep early.
prompt.zh: 选出最合适的答案。Choose the word that shows a result: She was tired, ___ she went to sleep early.

explain.en: So introduces the result of being tired: going to sleep early.
explain.zh: So 引出结果；因为累了，所以提早睡觉。

prompt.en: Choose the word that shows a contrast: He wanted to play outside, ___ it was raining.
prompt.zh: 选出最合适的答案。Choose the word that shows a contrast: He wanted to play outside, ___ it was raining.

explain.en: But contrasts wanting to play outside with the rainy weather.
explain.zh: But 表示转折，连接“想出去玩”和“正在下雨”这两个相反情况。

prompt.en: Choose the word that introduces a reason: I stayed home ___ I was sick.
prompt.zh: 选出最合适的答案。Choose the word that introduces a reason: I stayed home ___ I was sick.

explain.en: Because introduces the reason for staying home: being sick.
explain.zh: Because 引出待在家的原因，也就是生病。

prompt.en: Choose the word that shows a contrast: The test was difficult, ___ Aisyah still scored full marks.
prompt.zh: 选出最合适的答案。Choose the word that shows a contrast: The test was difficult, ___ Aisyah still scored full marks.

explain.en: But shows the contrast between a difficult test and a full score.
explain.zh: But 表示转折，连接“测验很难”和“仍然得满分”。

prompt.en: Choose the pair that shows a choice: You can have ___ tea or water.
prompt.zh: 选出最合适的答案。Choose the pair that shows a choice: You can have ___ tea or water.

explain.en: Either ... or presents a choice between two options.
explain.zh: Either ... or 表示两者之中选择其一，这里是茶或水。

prompt.en: One child, two ___.
prompt.zh: 选出正确的答案。One child, two ___.

explain.en: Child has an irregular plural: children, without an extra -s.
explain.zh: Child 的不规则复数是 children，不再加 -s。

prompt.en: One mouse, two ___.
prompt.zh: 选出正确的答案。One mouse, two ___.

explain.en: Mouse has the irregular plural mice.
explain.zh: Mouse 的不规则复数是 mice。

prompt.en: One tooth, two ___.
prompt.zh: 选出正确的答案。One tooth, two ___.

explain.en: Tooth changes its vowel to form the plural teeth.
explain.zh: Tooth 变复数时改变元音，写成 teeth。

prompt.en: One foot, two ___.
prompt.zh: 选出正确的答案。One foot, two ___.

explain.en: Foot has the irregular plural feet.
explain.zh: Foot 的不规则复数是 feet。

prompt.en: One box, two ___.
prompt.zh: 选出正确的答案。One box, two ___.

explain.en: Nouns ending in -x add -es: box becomes boxes.
explain.zh: 以 -x 结尾的名词变复数时加 -es：box → boxes。

prompt.en: One sheep, two ___.
prompt.zh: 选出正确的答案。One sheep, two ___.

explain.en: Sheep stays the same in singular and plural forms.
explain.zh: Sheep 的单数和复数形式相同，不加 -s。

prompt.en: One man, two ___.
prompt.zh: 选出正确的答案。One man, two ___.

explain.en: Man changes to men in the plural.
explain.zh: Man 的不规则复数是 men。

prompt.en: An elephant is ___ than a mouse. (big)
prompt.zh: 选出正确的答案。An elephant is ___ than a mouse. (big)

explain.en: Than compares two animals. Big doubles g and adds -er: bigger.
explain.zh: Than 表示比较两者；big 双写 g 后加 -er，变成 bigger。

prompt.en: This is the ___ book I have ever read. (good)
prompt.zh: 选出正确的答案。This is the ___ book I have ever read. (good)

explain.en: The best means the highest quality among all the books mentioned. Good has irregular forms better and best.
explain.zh: 这里比较读过的所有书，用最高级 best；good 的比较级是 better，最高级是 best。

prompt.en: My sister is ___ than me. (tall)
prompt.zh: 选出正确的答案。My sister is ___ than me. (tall)

explain.en: Than compares two people. Add -er to tall: taller.
explain.zh: Than 表示比较两人；tall 加 -er 变成 taller。

prompt.en: That was the ___ day of my life! (bad)
prompt.zh: 选出正确的答案。That was the ___ day of my life! (bad)

explain.en: Of my life compares that day with all the others; bad has the superlative worst.
explain.zh: 与一生中所有日子相比，要用最高级；bad 的最高级是 worst。

prompt.en: This puzzle is ___ than the last one. (difficult)
prompt.zh: 选出正确的答案。This puzzle is ___ than the last one. (difficult)

explain.en: Than signals a comparison. Use more before the longer adjective difficult.
explain.zh: Than 表示比较；较长的形容词 difficult 前加 more，形成 more difficult。

prompt.en: Of all the students, Hafiz is the ___. (careful)
prompt.zh: 选出正确的答案。Of all the students, Hafiz is the ___. (careful)

explain.en: Of all the students needs a superlative: most careful.
explain.zh: Of all 表示在所有学生当中比较，careful 的最高级是 most careful。

prompt.en: At the moment, the pupils ___ their models while their teacher watches.
prompt.zh: 选出最合适的答案。At the moment, the pupils ___ their models while their teacher watches.

explain.en: The plural pupils takes are making; at the moment tells us this is happening now.
explain.zh: Pupils 是复数；at the moment 表示此刻正在制作，所以用 are making。

prompt.en: Edit the verb: "Yesterday, Aina buy a stamp and posted a letter." Replace buy with ___.
prompt.zh: 选出最合适的答案。Edit the verb: "Yesterday, Aina buy a stamp and posted a letter." Replace buy with ___.

explain.en: Yesterday places both actions in the past. The irregular past form of buy is bought.
explain.zh: Yesterday 表示过去；buy 的不规则过去式是 bought，与 posted 的时态一致。

prompt.en: Choose the correct pair: Yesterday, we ___ to the lake and ___ some birds.
prompt.zh: 选出最合适的答案。Choose the correct pair: Yesterday, we ___ to the lake and ___ some birds.

explain.en: Both actions happened yesterday, so use the past forms went and saw.
explain.zh: 两个动作都发生在昨天，因此 go 和 see 都要变过去式：went 和 saw。

prompt.en: Ravi did not ___ his ruler, so he borrowed one.
prompt.zh: 选出最合适的答案。Ravi did not ___ his ruler, so he borrowed one.

explain.en: After did not, the main verb stays in its base form, bring.
explain.zh: Did not 后面的主要动词必须用原形 bring，不能再变过去式。

prompt.en: Did the visitors ___ the map before they entered the park?
prompt.zh: 选出最合适的答案。Did the visitors ___ the map before they entered the park?

explain.en: A past-simple question uses did + subject + base verb, so use check.
explain.zh: 一般过去式疑问句已有 Did，后面用动词原形 check。

prompt.en: Choose the pair: There ___ a bowl on the table, but there ___ no spoons.
prompt.zh: 选出最合适的答案。Choose the pair: There ___ a bowl on the table, but there ___ no spoons.

explain.en: A bowl is singular and spoons is plural: there is a bowl; there are no spoons.
explain.zh: A bowl 是单数，用 is；spoons 是复数，用 are。

prompt.en: A notice says, "You must ___ your name on the form before joining."
prompt.zh: 选出最合适的答案。A notice says, "You must ___ your name on the form before joining."

explain.en: Must is followed by a base verb, so write completes the instruction.
explain.zh: 情态动词 must 后接原形动词，所以用 write。

prompt.en: Choose the negative rule: Pupils ___ run beside the swimming pool because the floor is slippery.
prompt.zh: 选出最合适的答案。Choose the negative rule: Pupils ___ run beside the swimming pool because the floor is slippery.

explain.en: Because the floor is slippery, the rule needs must not to forbid running.
explain.zh: 地面很滑，因此规则应禁止奔跑；must not 表示“不准”。

prompt.en: Aina can swim, but her little brother ___ swim yet.
prompt.zh: 选出最合适的答案。Aina can swim, but her little brother ___ swim yet.

explain.en: Cannot + base verb describes an ability he does not have yet.
explain.zh: Cannot 加动词原形表示还不会做某件事；这里说弟弟还不会游泳。

prompt.en: Choose the pair: How ___ apples and how ___ water do we need?
prompt.zh: 选出最合适的答案。Choose the pair: How ___ apples and how ___ water do we need?

explain.en: Count apples separately with many; water is uncountable here and takes much.
explain.zh: Apples 可以逐个数，用 many；water 在这里是不可数名词，用 much。

prompt.en: There are only two eggs left. We have ___ eggs for the cake.
prompt.zh: 选出最合适的答案。There are only two eggs left. We have ___ eggs for the cake.

explain.en: Eggs are countable. A few means a small number, matching only two.
explain.zh: Eggs 是可数名词；a few 表示少量，符合只剩两颗鸡蛋的情况。

prompt.en: There is only a little juice left. Complete the statement: We do not have ___ juice.
prompt.zh: 选出最合适的答案。There is only a little juice left. Complete the statement: We do not have ___ juice.

explain.en: Juice is uncountable, so not much expresses a small amount.
explain.zh: Juice 是不可数名词；not much 表示剩下的量不多。

prompt.en: Lina is 140 cm tall. Siva is 145 cm tall. Lina is ___ than Siva.
prompt.zh: 选出最合适的答案。Lina is 140 cm tall. Siva is 145 cm tall. Lina is ___ than Siva.

explain.en: Lina is 5 cm shorter. Than requires the comparative form shorter.
explain.zh: Lina 比 Siva 矮 5 cm；than 表示两者比较，因此用 shorter。

prompt.en: Of the three bags, this one costs the least. It is the ___ bag.
prompt.zh: 选出最合适的答案。Of the three bags, this one costs the least. It is the ___ bag.

explain.en: The least expensive of three bags needs the superlative cheapest.
explain.zh: 三个书包中价格最低的，要用最高级 cheapest。

prompt.en: My brother and I made this kite. It is ___.
prompt.zh: 选出最合适的答案。My brother and I made this kite. It is ___.

explain.en: Ours stands alone and means belonging to my brother and me. Our needs a noun after it.
explain.zh: Ours 可以单独使用，表示“我们的”；our 后面必须接名词。

prompt.en: The teacher spoke to Aina and me. She asked ___ to carry the books.
prompt.zh: 选出最合适的答案。The teacher spoke to Aina and me. She asked ___ to carry the books.

explain.en: After asked, use the object pronoun us for Aina and me.
explain.zh: Asked 后面要用宾语代词；Aina and me 可用 us 代替。

prompt.en: These two bicycles belong to the boys. Choose the plural possessive phrase: the ___ bicycles.
prompt.zh: 选出最合适的答案。These two bicycles belong to the boys. Choose the plural possessive phrase: the ___ bicycles.

explain.en: For the plural boys, add an apostrophe after s to show ownership: boys'.
explain.zh: Boys 已经是以 s 结尾的复数名词，表示所属时在 s 后加撇号：boys'。

prompt.en: One child owns this lunchbox. It is the ___ lunchbox.
prompt.zh: 选出最合适的答案。One child owns this lunchbox. It is the ___ lunchbox.

explain.en: A single child takes apostrophe + s: child's lunchbox.
explain.zh: 一个孩子拥有的饭盒，用单数 child 加撇号和 s：child's。

prompt.en: Choose the word that introduces a reason: We brought reusable bags ___ we wanted to use less plastic.
prompt.zh: 选出最合适的答案。Choose the word that introduces a reason: We brought reusable bags ___ we wanted to use less plastic.

explain.en: Wanting to use less plastic is the reason for bringing reusable bags. Because introduces it.
explain.zh: 想减少塑料用量是携带环保袋的原因，应用 because 引出。

prompt.en: Complete the pair: ___ it was raining, the pupils stayed dry under the roof.
prompt.zh: 选出最合适的答案。Complete the pair: ___ it was raining, the pupils stayed dry under the roof.

explain.en: Although introduces a contrast: rain outside, but dry pupils under the roof.
explain.zh: Although 表示“虽然”，连接下雨与学生在屋檐下没被淋湿的转折关系。

prompt.en: Choose the pair: First, ___ the paper. Then, ___ it along the line.
prompt.zh: 选出最合适的答案。Choose the pair: First, ___ the paper. Then, ___ it along the line.

explain.en: Instructions begin with base verbs: fold and cut.
explain.zh: 祈使句发出指示时用动词原形，因此两格都用原形：fold、cut。

prompt.en: Choose the correct sentence about a habit.
prompt.zh: 选出最合适的答案。Choose the correct sentence about a habit.

choices: Farah usually walked to school every day now.

explain.en: Usually describes a habit. Singular Farah takes walks in the present simple.
explain.zh: Usually 表示习惯；Farah 是单数主语，一般现在式动词用 walks。

prompt.en: Choose the correct pair: A month ago, Danial ___ not ride a bicycle. Now he ___.
prompt.zh: 选出最合适的答案。Choose the correct pair: A month ago, Danial ___ not ride a bicycle. Now he ___.

explain.en: Could not describes past inability; can describes his ability now.
explain.zh: A month ago 表示过去，用 could not；now 表示现在会骑，用 can。

prompt.en: Aisyah is going to ___ a poster for the class exhibition tomorrow.
prompt.zh: 选出最合适的答案。Aisyah is going to ___ a poster for the class exhibition tomorrow.

explain.en: Be going to is followed by a base verb to describe a plan: design.
explain.zh: Be going to 后接动词原形表示计划，因此用 design。

prompt.en: Choose the correct pair: This is my ___ book, and those are my two ___ books.
prompt.zh: 选出最合适的答案。Choose the correct pair: This is my ___ book, and those are my two ___ books.

explain.en: One sister takes sister's. Two brothers takes brothers', with the apostrophe after the plural s.
explain.zh: 一个姐妹用 sister's；两个兄弟用复数 brothers，再把撇号加在 s 后。
